notes: Excluded as system. The learned ISAC-GNN outputs UE transmit power, RRU sensing activation and user association to maximize energy efficiency under a CRLB sensing constraint (p. 10, Eqs. 42-44; p. 11, semi-supervised loss), which is area 5 (resources that serve sensing and communication); checks 1 to 5 pass, since power allocation is a physical-layer decision learned jointly with user association. But every link has a single antenna at each end and there is no RIS. p. 3, Eq. (1) gives one scalar received signal per RRU with a scalar channel gain gkn, and "each UE's uplink payload is decoded locally at a single serving RRU"; p. 4: "The signal of each UE will be decoded at one RRU only". The body never mentions antennas, arrays, MIMO or RIS, and the channels are scalar Rayleigh fading with log-normal shadowing (p. 12). Borderline for the reviewer: the K single-antenna RRUs are fused non-coherently for multistatic localization (distributed-radar CRLB of [49], p. 4). If that distributed receiver counts as multi-antenna, the work would be included in area 5. The PDF (arXiv 2610.19612v1) matches the DOI: same title and authors as the Crossref record.
